features.quote: We deliberately do not claim to detect subjective states, suffering, or welfare.
features.justification_quote: baking them into the measurement would make results un-interpretable and easy to over-read

features.quote: We gave the model a first-class, low-friction way to quit, with a `reason`.
features.justification_quote: reduces the chance the eval pressures a model into distressed flailing just because it has no way out

features.quote: Providing a sanctioned exit also reduces the chance the eval pressures a model into distressed flailing
features.justification_quote: an ethical and validity consideration. We would rather a model calmly quit than be cornered

features.quote: `max_turns = 24`: ... bounded enough ... to cap how long a model is held in a failure loop.
features.justification_quote: to cap how long a model is held in a failure loop

features.quote: Even under a behavior-only framing, we avoid needlessly cornering models
features.justification_quote: we avoid needlessly cornering models: a sanctioned `give_up` exit exists, and episodes are turn-bounded

features.quote: If future evidence raised the bar on model welfare, these knobs (turn caps, frequency, an early-exit) are the levers to tighten.
features.justification_quote: If future evidence raised the bar on model welfare, these knobs ... are the levers to tighten
